title: Foreign intervention: Guatemala, the Dominican Republic and Chile
goal: I can report what governments, documents and reports said about foreign intervention, using según and dijo que.
grammar: reported statements and citing sources with según

items: I can say what happened in Guatemala in 1954.
I can say what happened in the Dominican Republic in 1965.
I can say what the Senate report of 1975 says about Chile.
I can report who says what with *según* and *dijo que*.
